mechanism_of_action: Liver-directed antisense inhibitor of diacylglycerol O-acyltransferase 2 (DGAT2), suppressing de novo lipogenesis.
primary_endpoint: At week 51, at least a 2-point reduction in NAS with at least a 1-point improvement in hepatocellular ballooning or lobular inflammation, without worsening of fibrosis.
efficacy_outcome: The primary endpoint was met by 18/39 (46%) with ION224 90 mg (risk difference vs placebo 27.4%, p=0.0094) and 20/34 (59%) with 120 mg (risk difference 40.1%, p=0.0002), versus 6/32 (19%) with placebo.
safety_signal: Adverse events occurred in 107 (94%) of ION224-treated participants and 41/46 (89%) receiving placebo. No deaths or treatment-related serious adverse events were reported; ION224 was described as safe and well tolerated.
